news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.19 (vs ₹0.14 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.19 (up from ₹0.14 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹239.0m (up 292% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹1.05m (up 38% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 0.4% (down from 1.3% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 13% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 16% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

news.title: New minor risk - Profit margin trend
news.body: The company's profit margins are lower than last year and have reduced by more than 30%. Net profit margin: 1.4% Last year net profit margin: 2.2% This is considered a minor risk. A large drop in profit margin could indicate the company does not have strong competitive advantages or it is yet to establish itself and its core business. Even if it is a well established business, this may make it a much riskier investment than one that has a combination of proven competitive advantages and a stable or growing profit margin.
